nodes.name: claude-md
nodes.summary: Add CLAUDE.md agent guide for this repository
nodes.body:
Build/test commands, the core-module pipeline, invariants to preserve,
and repo conventions (embed-source sync, append-only ADR log, E2E plan
placement) — everything a future agent needs before touching the code.

nodes.name: crash-protocol
nodes.summary: Adopt journal-first crash bookkeeping with void ops
nodes.body:
The old order (flip the branch, then record the op) had an unfixable
crash window: a flip without a record leaves nothing to repair from.
Apply now journals the op on refs/isomer/data first and flips second;
a crash leaves the books one step ahead, which reconcile() detects and
cancels with an appended `void` op — the log never claims a state the
branch does not have. Op walks skip void entries and their targets;
status/apply/undo reconcile on entry, and a raced ref flip voids its
own journal entry (E101). The data-ref writer is generalized to
carried-forward subtrees with an optional op payload along the way.
Design: D21.

nodes.name: comments
nodes.summary: Add review comments anchored to change identities
nodes.body:
`ism comment add/list/resolve`: comments live as comments/<c-id>.json
on the data ref, anchored to change ids (never commit shas — those are
rewritten by reorganization). Comment-only data commits carry no ops/
tree, so op walks skip them naturally. Threading via `parent`; resolve
is idempotent. `comment list` emits the full set as JSON — one channel
shared by the desktop app (rendering) and coding agents (fix loop).
Design: D22.

nodes.name: e2e-hardening
nodes.summary: Harden the E2E suite: moved-HEAD, CRLF, signing, crash, comments
nodes.body:
Tree equality is only evidence when HEAD actually moved — assert it
(lesson from a false-pass during manual verification). New coverage:
CRLF bytes round-trip bit-for-bit, signing failure is E050 and leaves
branch and data ref untouched, a dangling op is voided and the same
plan re-applies cleanly, and the full comment lifecycle.
